name: check_role_change_authorized
description: check_role_change_authorized: Confirm that HR has pre-approved a role change for an employee before any permission modifications are made. Returns the HR case ID and the approved effective date on success, or not_authorized if HR has not approved the role change.

employee_id.description: The employee requesting the permission change (e.g. EMP048271).

new_role_code.description: The role code the employee is transitioning to (e.g. MGENG).
